name: Jump Rhythm
memo: Van Halen - Jump: rhythm/riff. Brown amp (hot-rodded plexi style), light boost, subtle phaser. Approximation, tweak by ear.

band.style_feel: moderate straight eighths, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, synth-driven pop-rock
band.key: C major (solo reported in B-flat minor by some sources)
parts: Part A: intro synth riff - drums and bass enter after a few bars
Part B: verse - tight, steady groove
Part D: guitar solo - full band, driving
Part E: final chorus and outro - full band
band.tips: Tempo is about 129 BPM per Wikipedia. The song is keyboard-led, so play the guitar as accents and chords under the synth; keep strumming steady while the Trio+ learns.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
how: Leave the Whammy DT off; play in standard tuning.
whammy.tips: No pitch effect was found for this song in the sources; none is set.

originals.guitar: Eddie Van Halen's modified Frankenstrat-style guitar (humbucker in bridge)

guitar.position: bridge pickup, volume full (back off a little for the cleaner solo), tone at 10
guitar.tone_notes: Bright, crisp, fairly open humbucker tone from a modified Marshall plexi with a phaser. A single-coil guitar will be thinner: add a bit of gain and mids.

name: Jump Solo
memo: Van Halen - Jump: solo. Brown amp with more gain and mids, a touch of delay.
